name: Town quay · Stern-to
description: Wait outside the breakwater while a monohull leaves, come in through the entrance, turn in the basin and back into a free slot on the south town quay, bow north, with an onshore breeze pushing you onto the quay.
author: Leopard (independent stage author)

radio.yield: Departing monohull holding position: you are in the channel. Give way and return to the holding area.

steps.label: HOLD
steps.title: Wait outside the breakwater.
steps.hint: A monohull is about to leave the harbour. Keep your boat's centre in the blue holding area west of the entrance for 8 seconds; it casts off once you are in position. Use the time to put fenders out on both sides (Crew & lines).
steps.linesRefused: Not yet: wait outside the breakwater first

radio.start: Leopard, Town Harbour Control. This is a game, not certified training. Your berth is the free slot on the town quay, stern-to, lazy line provided. A monohull is departing: hold in the area west of the entrance and keep the channel clear.
radio.enter: Holding area reached. The monohull casts off in 8 seconds. Fenders out port and starboard while you wait.
radio.reset: You left the holding area. The count restarts when you are back inside.
radio.done: Monohull under way, outbound through the entrance. Keep clear of the channel until it has passed.

steps.label: HOLD
steps.title: Let the monohull pass.
steps.hint: Stay west of the channel while the monohull motors out through the entrance, keeping to its starboard side. You are called in once it is clear.
steps.linesRefused: Not yet: wait until you are called in

radio.done: Channel clear. Leopard, enter harbour keeping to the starboard (west) side of the entrance and proceed to the turning basin.

steps.label: ENTER
steps.title: Enter and turn in the basin.
steps.hint: Come in through the entrance between the lights, on the starboard (west) side: red light to port, green light to starboard. Keep your boat's centre in the blue turning basin for 5 seconds and turn so your stern faces the quay: you will back in bow north.
steps.linesRefused: Not yet: get into the slot first

radio.enter: In the turning basin. The breeze is onshore from the north: it will push you onto the quay as you back in.
radio.reset: You left the turning basin. The count restarts when you are back inside.
radio.done: Proceed to the free slot between the monohull and the catamaran. Stern-to, bow north.

steps.label: INTO THE SLOT
steps.title: Back into the slot, stern first.
steps.hint: Line up north of the slot with the bow pointing north and back down slowly. The onshore breeze carries you towards the quay: use less astern than you think and a touch ahead to stop. Straighten up in the mint box with the stern about a metre off the quay and hold still for 3 seconds.
steps.linesRefused: Stop in the mint box first, then pass the stern lines

radio.start: Dead slow astern into the slot. The wind is behind you going in: stop early, the transom has no fenders.
radio.done: Stopped in the slot. Stern lines to T11 and T12, then pick up the lazy line.

steps.label: SECURE
steps.title: Stern lines, then the lazy line.
steps.hint: Make fast the port quarter line to T11 and the starboard quarter line to T12 from Crew & lines, in neutral. Then pick up the lazy line at the quay and lead it to the bow.
steps.hintAlongside: Amber area: pick up the lazy line once a stern line is on, then Take in until it holds the bow up into the wind and the stern off the quay. Keep both levers in neutral.

radio.done: Secured stern-to on the town quay. Welcome to Town Harbour.

rules.radio: Leopard, keep out of the channel: vessel departing. Return to the holding area. +{penalty} s
rules.check: Keep out of the channel until called in

complete.title: Berthed on the town quay.
complete.hint: Moored with +{penalty} s penalties. Open the debrief for your score and one thing to try; Retry (R) to go again.
complete.radio: Secured stern-to in {time} s with +{penalty} s penalties. A game, not certified training: practise this with an instructor on the water.

tips.contacts: You touched something {count}× (the quay or a neighbour). With the wind behind you going in, back in slower and stop the boat a metre off the quay with a touch ahead.
tips.trafficClearance: You came within {gap} m of the {vessel}. Give departing traffic at least {clearance} m: wait in the holding area until it is through the entrance.
tips.countdownResets: You drifted out of a blue area {count}×. Hold position head to wind with small, early lever corrections.
tips.earlyEntries: You entered the channel before the monohull was clear. Wait in the holding area for the radio call.
tips.fendersLate: Your fenders were not out on both sides when you arrived. Put them out while you wait outside the breakwater: the crew needs 3 seconds.
tips.failed: {failure}. Fenders only cover the sides of your hulls: keep your bow and stern clear of the neighbours, keep well clear of the departing monohull, and have fenders out on both sides before you back in.
